facts.fact: The Ministry of Local Government of the Government of National Unity runs the National Programme for Activating Local Revenues, under which 27 municipalities signed a sponsorship document on 10 June 2024; its projects include an electronic collection system and a database of municipal economic activities.

facts.fact: The ministry's national programme sets out an action plan for municipalities to activate and grow local revenue, with projects on economic-activity revenue, electronic collection, revenue regulations and a forum; 27 municipalities committed to implement it on 10 June 2024.
facts.system: نظام الإيرادات المحلية (local revenue system) / منظومة الجباية الإلكترونية

facts.fact: The programme director said it targets both municipalities where the local revenue system is already activated and those where it is not and still needs activating; no count of either group is given, and the 27 signatories are not said to be using the system.

systems.tiers: municipalities; activated in some, not in others, no count given
